providers.name: Galaxy, procedurally generated by scripts/generate-procedural-textures.mjs (no third-party material)

review.note: Checked live (2026-08-26): no controlled global mosaic published by USGS. Procedural texture: moderate cratering only — Titania's real defining feature is its canyon network (Messina Chasmata, ~1500 km), which this generator cannot represent (no linear-groove primitive), documented as a known limitation rather than approximated inaccurately.
